step1.title: Welcome {{name}}!
step1.subtitle: Two details to calibrate your feed. You can change everything in settings.
step1.nameHint: The name others see next to your problems and answers.
step1.nameError: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.

levels.beginner: The feed favours approachable problems and well-explained answers.
levels.intermediate: A mix: things to learn, and problems where you can already help.
levels.senior: The feed favours sharp problems and those still waiting for an answer.

step2.title: What do you code on?
step2.subtitle: Pick at least 3 topics. They are a starting point: the feed then adjusts to what you actually read.

github.title: Save time with GitHub
github.hint: We only read your public repositories (languages and topics) to suggest interests. Nothing is saved without your say.
github.label: Your GitHub username (optional)
github.invalid: This GitHub username is not in a valid format.
github.notFound: No GitHub account with that name. Check the spelling, or pick your topics below.
github.rateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Pick your topics below, it works just as well.
github.network: Could not reach GitHub. Pick your topics below, it works just as well.
github.empty: No usable public repository for {{login}}. Pick your topics below.
github.found_one: {{count}} topic found for {{login}}, already ticked. Untick it if it is not you.
github.found_other: {{count}} topics found for {{login}}, already ticked. Untick the ones that are not you.

step3.title: Here is why your feed will look like this
step3.subtitle: No black box: this is the starting point, and you stay in control.

explain.title: Every card says why it is there
explain.body: “You follow React”, “at your level”, “unanswered”: the reason is written on the problem.

steer.title: You tune the feed yourself
steer.body: Turn a topic up or down, mute it, or say “less of this” on a card.

explore.title: A share of exploration, clearly labelled
explore.body: Now and then, a topic outside your habits, so you do not go round in circles.
